Q5167.reason: Many OTC cold remedies already contain paracetamol, so patients must check labels to avoid accidental overdose; it treats pyrexia and is not limited to PRN use.

Q5168.reason: An express easement is not abandoned by mere non-use; abandonment requires acts showing intent to relinquish it, which a work absence does not supply.

Q5169.reason: Long-chain fatty acyl groups cross the inner mitochondrial membrane via the carnitine shuttle as acylcarnitine, not bound to CoA.
